data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: dso-setup.sh is provider/toolchain-blind — hardcodes Python/Poetry/GitHub/Jira/pre-commit bundle regardless of Socratic dialog choices. Classification: COMPLEX — epic-shaped. Full fix requires: new provider.* namespace in dso-config.conf, dialog changes in onboarding SKILL.md, per-artifact gates in dso-setup.sh, new CI/hook/tracker/host template variants, and integration tests per (provider × stack) combination. Defect A (honor dialog opt-outs) is the only candidate for standalone bug-fix treatment; B–G require the full epic. Triage comment in the ticket is well-reasoned and should be used as brainstorm seed. Leaving OPEN; not autonomously invoking /dso:brainstorm.
